## R3 exact tests
1. From an **81 addressed × 27 observations per particle** synthetic event ledger, prove after serialization/readback that every particle's past input notes are individually retained. Compare 10,000,000,000 logical year steps by direct recurrence only at tiny horizons and modular matrix/phase jump at 10 billion. Never say 10 billion physical years elapsed.
2. Each per-particle state uses order-three recurrence `rotate3(state,Δt)` between events; after the last event, fast-forward `Δt mod 3`. This is exact under **this declared fixed per-particle law**, not an arbitrary nonlinear many-body gravitational simulation or continuous dynamics. Any particle with independent inputs receives its own append-only event and cannot be recreated solely from address seed.
3. For b/d, use simplified **fixed circular orbital-phase model** constrained to measured periods b=11.18465 and d=5.12338 days, integer-scaled to 100000. Compute phase at `10^10` years and at time+1, compare direct 729-year reference (integer cycle), and flag long-horizon physical state **INVALID_AS_ASTRONOMICAL_PREDICTION** from orbital period uncertainty, unknown interactions and stellar evolution.
4.
